name: Carpool (drivers, departure times, gas split)
use_when: getting a group somewhere in several cars: drivers with seats and a time each car leaves
'carpool to the away game', 'who's driving to the formal', 'drivers say when you're leaving', 'pickup run for the couch, split gas'
drivers offered cars in the chat, maybe with gas or parking money
dont_use_when: calling seats in cars already sorted, no times or drivers to coordinate (use slots)
picking one person to drive (use wheel)
a headcount for the trip itself (use lock)
guarantees: each person is in one car at most, as driver or rider; riders never exceed a car's seats
a join takes an open seat or does nothing; joining another car moves you out of your old one
a car's cost splits evenly across everyone in it in integer cents, the driver takes the leftover cents, and the shares add up to the cost
anyone can offer a car or take the wheel of a car with no driver; departure times and costs never change after they are set
a leaver's seat opens up, or their car needs a new driver; a late joiner can ride or drive

title.description: Where everyone is going, e.g. 'Away game at Stanford'

driver.description: Driver, exactly as in the members list, or empty if the car needs one

seats.description: Rider seats, not counting the driver, 1 to 7

leaves.description: When the car leaves, short: '5:30 PM', 'after class'

costCents.description: Gas and parking for this car in cents, 0 if none
